findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: An employee was observed washing hands and turning off the faucet without using a barrier. The employee was educated by the inspector on proper handwashing procedures, and the person-in-charge (PIC) was instructed to review proper handwashing practices with all employees. Ensure a barrier, such as a paper towel, is used to turn off the faucet after handwashing to prevent recontamination of clean hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door. [C]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The pizza holder machine was observed to have food debris accumulation from the previous day. CORRECTED: The inspector advised the PIC to always clean the pizza holder machine at the end of the day after food operation hours since it is a food contact surface. The machine was cleaned to sight and touch by an employee during the inspection. Ensure food contact surfaces are kept free of food debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: A sanitizer bucket was not observed at the facility when the inspector arrived. CORRECTED: The PIC prepared a sanitizer bucket at the start of the inspection. Ensure sanitizer bucket is available and replaced every 2 - 4 hours during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-702.11 Before Use After Cleaning. UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be SANITIZED before use after cleaning. [P]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: There was no certified food protection manager present during today’s inspection. PIC informed inspector upon arrival that they are currently in the process of getting the examination for the certification done. Ensure that there is at least one staff member that is a certified food protection manager in the facility during operational hours at all times.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the area of wall around the mop sink to be in disrepair. The wall was removed during the winter due to an issue where some plumbing froze. Replace the drywall and seal the mop sink to the wall on all sides. 
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor. 

Inspector observed boxes of chips stored on the floor of the dry storage area. Chips were moved up onto shelves and the chest freezer. Provide proper storage for food and items that require protection. Violation is considered corrected on site. The facility manager states that he is planning to provide more shelves to the area.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 

Inspector observed boats for single service to be stored with food surface exposed to potential contamination. Boats were inverted at time of inspection. Store boats and all single use items inverted and/or protected. Violation was corrected on site.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

Observed thawed hot dogs to not bear any date marking. Facility otherwise utilizes frozen or non-TTC foods. Discussed date marking system with employees. Date was put on hot dogs. Ensure date marking system is upheld. COS.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC. 

Observed lack of signed employee health reporting agreements. Facility previously had documents signed; however, a new manager is now operating at facility and the reports were lost. Discussed with PIC. PIC made copies and will have all food handling employees sign within 10 days. Inspector will follow-up on 3/26/21.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris. 

Observed multiple areas of a bathroom (farthest right in the jungle gym area) to have portions of the wall missing. A ceiling panel is missing, as well. PIC indicated that plumbing had been an issue and repairs were being conducted.
